title: Spacetime Stabilization Upgrade
text: Forge an Elemental Crystal Grid with three Spacetime Knots and three Paradox Dust in any outer order. Installed globes retain contents and upgrades when mined and cannot be trampled.

Item forms of Crystal Balls, Liquid Crystal Balls and Cruise Orbs with this upgrade may only be carried in your inventory or placed on a Crystal Pedestal. Other containers cannot accept them, even when their contents are empty.
